actus.title: BREAKING NEWS - Francis Joyon (Oceans) safe aboard a cargo ship
actus.excerpt: After his boat capsized on Monday, November 2nd, around 3 p.m., Francis Joyon was rescued by the cargo ship Maersk Columbus at 11 p.m. The skipper of the Vintage Multi Oceans is doing well and is currently en route to Ireland where he will disembark in the coming hours.

actus.title: BREAKING NEWS - Francis Joyon (Oceans) has capsized
actus.excerpt: Francis Joyon s’est retourné à bord de son ORMA Océans. D’après les premiers éléments fournis le skipper confirme qu’il n’est pas blessé. Une opération de secours, en concertation avec la direction de course, a été déclenchée avec le CROSS* de Jobourg et les autorités britanniques.

actus.title: 📸 View from onboard: second afternoon of racing
Crown duels. Head-to-heads increase the pace.
actus.excerpt: The leaders of the Route du Rhum Destination Guadeloupe, the Ultim giants of the ocean, were making the best of the fast conditions as they sprint westwards on the second day of racing since leaving Saint-Malo in beautiful sunshine and modest breezes Sunday lunchtime.
